matte.meaning: Traveller-only coverage; excludes guardians, Shadow, furniture and scene props

slots.skin: face, ears, neck, exposed arms, hands, fingers and exposed legs
slots.hair: all authored hair and eyebrows; excludes leather, wood, straps and boots
slots.eyes: only canonical black Traveller eye marks, including authored closed-eye lines; never sclera, iris, highlights, mouth, nose, outline or guardian eyes

invariants: default palette returns the original base asset without pixel processing
RGB outside the semantic channel union is copied pixel-for-pixel
semantic coverage is a subset of the approved Traveller matte
all mattes and masks contain coverage; skin and hair are always non-empty; eyes are empty only for an explicitly declared back view
mask and matte PNGs contain no ICC, gAMA, sRGB, cHRM or transparency metadata
an incomplete or missing mask fails closed and cannot authorize runtime options
